**Title: "Whispers of the Deep"**

In the heart of the forest,  
A walnut tree stands tall, its branches  
Whispering to the sea.

Beneath the vast ocean,  
A whale sings to the moonlit waves,  
Dreaming of the land.

One stormy night, the whale  
Rises to the surface, its song  
Echoing through the trees.

The walnut tree listens,  
Its leaves rustling in response,  
A bridge between worlds.

In the morning light,  
A single walnut falls into  
The waiting sea below.

The whale, curious,  
Gently nudges the nut, feeling  
A connection unseen.

Thus, the whale and the tree  
Form an unspoken bond, their lives  
Tied by whispers and dreams.

This haiku captures the mystical and serene connection between two seemingly unrelated elements of nature, highlighting the hidden ties that bind all living things.
